stories.title: Plan the stories on a board in the window
stories.description:
The operator sees every story by state, the most important first, opens a story or an issue, and changes a story’s state by drag and drop, read from and written through a story API whose states are configured, not built in; a state change calls an action API.

Open Planning, find each story in its state’s column sorted by priority, open a story and one of its issues, drag a story to another state and save; the change is in porelo-project’s checkout. Rename a state in the configuration and the board shows it.

The website builds in its task
Make security failures hold the release
Reach a remote machine from Windows
The host run by a program of its own, built like porelo
stories.description:
# The host tool

The host runs through a packaged native program.

The host is run by porelo-host, a native program packaged like porelo, instead of scripts copied onto it.

Rent a host, bring it up with porelo-host and run a move on it; every verb answers as the old scripts did.

stories.title: A whole move rehearsed by the agents on a rented server
stories.description:
The agents rehearse a whole move on a rented server before the operator’s own test, so most problems are found earlier.

Rent a server and let the agents run the rehearsal; the report names every scenario OK, and the window and the room agree with the host.

issues.title: An issue in a state outside the workflow
issues.text: **What must be true.** The work meets the issue description.

warnings.text: Its state is none of the workflow's states, so no work starts on it.

issues.title: An issue without a priority
issues.text: **What must be true.** The work meets the issue description.

warnings.text: It has no priority, so it is sorted as Medium.

issues.title: An issue whose id stands twice
issues.text: **What must be true.** The work meets the issue description.

warnings.text: Its id names another item too, so it can be neither worked nor moved until one id is changed.

issues.title: An issue whose parent is outside the project
issues.text: **What must be true.** The work meets the issue description.

warnings.text: Its parent is outside the project and is not shown.

issues.title: An issue waiting on an issue outside the project
issues.text: **What must be true.** The work meets the issue description.

warnings.text: An issue it waits on is outside the project and is not shown.

issues.title: An issue under another parent than its id names
issues.text: **What must be true.** The work meets the issue description.

warnings.text: It stands under another parent than its id names.

issues.title: An issue whose text has no sections
issues.text: **What must be true.** The work meets the issue description.

warnings.text: Its text has no sections the planner can read; it is shown as it stands.

issues.title: The other issue whose id stands twice
issues.text: **What must be true.** The work meets the issue description.

warnings.text: Its id names another item too, so it can be neither worked nor moved until one id is changed.

issues.title: An issue marked a story outside the stories' repository
issues.text: **What must be true.** The work meets the issue description.

warnings.text: It is marked a story outside the repository that holds the stories, so it is shown as an issue and no work starts on it.

issues.title: An issue whose parent is in another repository
issues.text: **What must be true.** The work meets the issue description.

warnings.text: Its parent is in another repository, so it is shown without its parent.

issues.title: An issue blocked by a story
issues.text: **What must be true.** The work meets the issue description.

warnings.text: It is blocked by a story, which only an issue can block, so it is shown without that blocker.

issues.title: An issue whose parents lead back to it
issues.text: **What must be true.** The work meets the issue description.

warnings.text: Its parents lead back to it, so it is shown without its parent.

issues.title: A sub-issue of a sub-issue
issues.text: **What must be true.** The work meets the issue description.

warnings.text: Its parent is a sub-issue itself, which the board cannot hold, so it is shown without its parent.

issues.title: An issue read past one page
issues.text: **What must be true.** The work meets the issue description.

warnings.text: It has more sub-issues, blockers, labels or field values than one page carries, so it is shown as far as it was read.

issues.title: An issue that hangs on one the board does not place
issues.text: **What must be true.** The work meets the issue description.

warnings.text: An issue it stands under or waits on is not placed on the board, so it is shown without that link.
